study type: Interventional study (quasi-experimental or randomized controlled trial, implied by 'experimental group' and 'control group')
outcome: ability to cope with labour pains
cohort: The participants were primigravid women undergoing labor.
finding: The Lamaze method was effective in improving the childbirth experience, helping mothers cope with labor pains, shortening the duration of labor, and increasing the rate of vaginal births.
mod_finding: The experimental group mothers had more vaginal births compared to control group mothers, showing a statistically significant difference in mode of labor.
